releases.notes: - `!ai` in party chat now works as a short form of `!allinvite`, toggling the party's All Invite setting when you are the leader.

- The Dungeon Splits HUD now shows your pace next to your PB instead of Best possible: your splits so far in this run, plus your average over your last 10 runs for each split still to come. The separate Pace Timer setting is gone, since pace is always shown there now.

- Sky-Myce now also runs on Minecraft 26.2. It is a separate jar from the 26.1.2 one, and each updates from its own channel: a 26.2 install only gets 26.2 builds, and a 26.1.2 install keeps getting 26.1.2 builds. Nothing changes if you stay on 26.1.2.
- On 26.2, the live player views in the Leap menu (Leap POV) and the Crush Camera are not available yet and show as unavailable. Everything else works the same as on 26.1.2.
- Minecraft 26.2 uses Vulkan graphics by default. With Vulkan, Sky-Myce draws its menus with its simpler fallback renderer, because the normal one needs OpenGL. Menus still work; switching graphics back to OpenGL in Video Settings brings the normal renderer back.

Sky-Myce 2.8.0 for Minecraft 26.1.2 and Java 25.

This release expands the Greenhouses experience with plot-aware layouts, grouped crop shopping and seed crafting, mutation growth tracking, and clearer analyzer highlights. It also improves Goldor coordination by excluding players who are not in the current run's party, alongside related stability and usability fixes.

Download the standalone Fabric mod JAR below. Close Minecraft before replacing the mod, keep its Fabric dependencies installed, and open `/sm` to configure features. See the [player guide](https://github.com/cessna80808-star/Sky-Myce/blob/2.8.0/MANUAL.md).

Sky-Myce 2.5.15 for Minecraft 26.1.2 and Java 25.

This release brings the custom menu renderer and navigation, Global Chat media and controls, dungeon camera and routing improvements, and stability fixes.

Download the standalone Fabric mod JAR below. Close Minecraft before replacing the mod, keep its Fabric dependencies installed, and open `/sm` to configure features. Local features work without Discord or a custom Loader; see the [player guide](https://github.com/cessna80808-star/Sky-Myce/blob/2.5.15/MANUAL.md).
